title: A little-known immune cell could explain why some small cell lung cancer patients respond to immunotherapy
desc: γδ T cells infiltrate small cell lung cancer tumors and can kill them without the MHC-I machinery these tumors typically switch off, and patients with more of them trended toward longer survival on anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy.
